## 📌 Description of Changes

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made in this Pull Request.

Fixes #(issue)

---

## 🔍 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] ⚠️ Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing code to change)
- [ ] 📄 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️ Infrastructure / CI/CD pipeline change

---

## 🧪 Verification & Testing

- [ ] Local Pytest suite passes (`poetry run pytest`).
- [ ] Code formatting & linting clean (`poetry run ruff check .` and `poetry run black --check .`).
- [ ] Static type checking clean (`poetry run mypy backend`).
- [ ] Added new unit/integration tests for new features.

---

## 🛡️ Security & Quality Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project architectural standards and ADR guidelines.
- [ ] Secrets or API keys are NOT hardcoded in code or committed.
- [ ] Documentation updated to reflect changes (if applicable).
